fairness.primary: The learned MAP operating point is frozen before analytic fallback evaluation.
fairness.backfill: Complete SPC-MAP uses released NoLan beta=0.8 only when the learned route retains the native answer.
fairness.selection: The primary analytic fallback is fixed. A support-gated fallback is retained only as a development-selected diagnostic under the same four-point CS budget; no test label or side identity is used.
